boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-admission activities at Norwich and in Northfield, with free access documented by the university or local library.

cards.title: Explore the Sullivan Museum
cards.subtitle: Kreitzberg Library, 158 Harmon Drive
cards.notes: Enter through Kreitzberg Library or the Bicentennial Stairs, then spend time with the rotating exhibits and collection displays.
cards.short_summary: A free museum visit centered on Norwich history and changing exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Norwich lists museum admission as free and says it is accessible via Kreitzberg Library or the Bicentennial Stairs.
cards.source_title: Sullivan Museum and History Center | Norwich University
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–4 p.m.; closed during university closures. Admission is free.

cards.title: Hike from the Shaw Outdoor Center
cards.subtitle: Shaw Outdoor Center trail network
cards.notes: Start at the Shaw Outdoor Center and choose a trail suitable for your group; use the published maps and follow posted trail policies.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost hike on the outdoor center’s trail access network.
cards.evidence_claim: Norwich says the Shaw Outdoor Center provides free access to trails for hiking.
cards.source_title: Incoming Students and Families | Norwich University
cards.access_notes: Norwich describes free access to outdoor recreational equipment and trails; check trail maps and policies before leaving.

cards.title: Mountain-bike the Shaw trails
cards.subtitle: Shaw Outdoor Center trail network
cards.notes: Use a bike you already have or inquire about the center’s available equipment, then ride only on trails and conditions listed in its policies.
cards.short_summary: A free-access mountain-biking option beside campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Norwich says the Shaw Outdoor Center provides free access to outdoor recreational equipment and trails for mountain biking.
cards.source_title: Incoming Students and Families | Norwich University
cards.access_notes: Use the Shaw Outdoor Center’s current maps and trail policies; its free-access statement includes equipment and trails.

cards.title: Cross-country ski the trail network
cards.subtitle: Shaw Outdoor Center trail network
cards.notes: When snow conditions allow, confirm the route on the trail map, bring layers, and use the center’s designated cross-country-ski access.
cards.short_summary: A winter trail activity included in Norwich’s free outdoor access.
cards.evidence_claim: Norwich says the Shaw Outdoor Center provides free access to outdoor recreational equipment and trails for cross-country skiing.
cards.source_title: Incoming Students and Families | Norwich University
cards.access_notes: Seasonal conditions apply. Norwich’s free-access statement specifically includes cross-country skiing.

cards.title: Snowshoe from the Shaw Outdoor Center
cards.subtitle: Shaw Outdoor Center trail network
cards.notes: Check snow and trail conditions before heading out, then use marked routes and equipment appropriate for a short group outing.
cards.short_summary: A free winter walk on the outdoor center’s trail access network.
cards.evidence_claim: Norwich says the Shaw Outdoor Center provides free access to outdoor recreational equipment and trails for snowshoeing.
cards.source_title: Incoming Students and Families | Norwich University
cards.access_notes: Seasonal conditions apply. Norwich’s free-access statement specifically includes snowshoeing.

cards.title: Trail-run from Shaw Outdoor Center
cards.subtitle: Shaw Outdoor Center trail network
cards.notes: Pick a marked route that matches your pace, tell a friend where you are going, and yield appropriately on shared trails.
cards.short_summary: A free-access trail-running option close to campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Norwich says the Shaw Outdoor Center provides free access to outdoor recreational equipment and trails for trail running.
cards.source_title: Incoming Students and Families | Norwich University
cards.access_notes: Use the published maps and trail policies. Norwich’s free-access statement specifically includes trail running.

cards.entity_name: Brown Public Library free library card
cards.title: Set up a Brown Library card
cards.subtitle: Brown Public Library, 93 South Main Street
cards.notes: Visit during open hours and ask staff about eligibility and account setup, then use the card to access the library’s free digital offerings.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost library-card route to local digital resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Brown Public Library invites visitors to get a free library card and advertises free eBooks and audiobooks.
cards.access_notes: Confirm eligibility with library staff; the library advertises free library cards and free digital materials.

cards.title: Read a library eBook
cards.subtitle: Brown Public Library digital collection
cards.notes: Use the Palace app information on the library site to browse available eBooks and begin a reading break from your phone or tablet.
cards.short_summary: A digital reading hang using the library’s advertised free eBook collection.
cards.evidence_claim: Brown Public Library says its Palace app offers thousands of free eBooks and audiobooks.
cards.access_notes: Library account requirements may apply; Brown Public Library describes the eBooks and audiobooks as free.

cards.title: Queue up a library audiobook
cards.subtitle: Brown Public Library digital collection
cards.notes: Browse the library’s Palace app collection, choose an audiobook, and listen while walking around town or relaxing between classes.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost listening activity from the local public library’s digital collection.
cards.evidence_claim: Brown Public Library says its Palace app offers thousands of free eBooks and audiobooks.
cards.access_notes: Library account requirements may apply; Brown Public Library describes the eBooks and audiobooks as free.

cards.entity_name: Brown Public Library LEGO Robotics Kits
cards.title: Build with a LEGO Robotics Kit
cards.subtitle: Brown Public Library, 93 South Main Street
cards.notes: Reserve a two-hour library session by phone or email, then use the kit on site during open hours; younger participants need adult supervision.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on, no-cost robotics activity offered for in-library use.
cards.evidence_claim: Brown Public Library says LEGO Robotics Kits are available for use at the library and that library cards are free for Northfield residents.
cards.source_title: LEGO Robotics Kits Available at BPL - Brown Public Library
cards.access_notes: A library card is required; confirm eligibility and kit availability before visiting. Kits are for in-library use during open hours.
